title: Account Manager
description:
About Us

We are Ocado Commercial, and we are revolutionising online grocery. We partner with the world's leading retailers, providing our innovative Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) - a powerful blend of automation and software - to elevate their e-commerce capabilities. Join us and be part of a team that's shaping the future of retail, working with global giants from Kroger to AEON.

About the Role

The Account Manager role is an exciting opportunity in our account management team to directly influence the commercial success of our Partners. This position will require extensive travel to Saudi Arabia.

We are looking for a strategic and commercially driven e-commerce leader to join our account management team. In this role, you will own the strategy to drive online growth for our partners, ensuring commercial success, operational efficiency, and international scalability.

This role is hybrid, working 2 days per week in our UK Head Office in Hatfield, and 3 days per week from home. Regular travel to our partners’ offices and operational sites will be required, including extensive travel to Saudi Arabia.

Your main mission will be to drive the success of your account, supporting your partner to achieve our joint goals. You will develop and maintain strong relationships, help your partner to grow its online business, as well as realising new commercial opportunities for Ocado.

• Account Development:

• Developing, updating and owning partnership strategy that aligns with the partner's e-commerce goals, focusing on identifying and maximising opportunities for market share growth and operational optimisation

• Responsible for overseeing the overall delivery of the agreed partnership goals, including building a strong internal collaboration network and securing appropriate support to meet those partnership goals

• Primary interface between Ocado and the partner for all relationship matters, including escalations

• Pursuing opportunities to develop the partner relationship further, from creative idea generation, business case development, commercial negotiation and overseeing implementation

• Ensuring that Operations are supporting Growth and that teams are aligned with the same objectives and KPIs

• Partner Growth:

• Owning the shaping and delivery of a strategy to help your partners grow and improve their commercial outcomes 

• Leveraging data to provide regular reporting to internal and external stakeholders, highlighting key trends and opportunities to improve growth 

• Delivering actionable recommendations partners can implement within their organizations to support growth

• Becoming an expert on all the relevant OSP features that can support growth, and ensuring your partners are fully utilising these features to drive their goals.  

• Delivering against agreed partnership goals, including building a strong internal collaboration network and securing appropriate support to meet these partnership goals

• Maintaining strong awareness of the market your partner operates in and providing timely and actionable recommendations to help them take advantage of opportunities

About you

• Languages: Fluency in English is essential. Arabic is highly preferred. European languages are also highly desirable.

•  Years of proven track record in one or several of the following fields:

• Developing and executing online growth strategies within a direct to consumer business with complex logistics (grocery ecommerce experience a big plus).

• Retail and/or strategy management consulting experience, with projects focusing on growth and/or logistics.

• Hypergrowth start-ups or scale-ups

• Familiarity and passion for data-driven marketing, consumer insight, and ecommerce

• Familiarity with or experience with measuring and optimising key growth metrics including user growth, conversion, LTV

• Experienced in relationship building and working in leading multi-disciplinary teams 

• Comfortable utilising data

title: Channel Sales Manager
description:
EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS | Introduction

Exclusive Networks is the global cybersecurity go-to-market specialist that provides partners and end-customers with a wide range of services and product portfolios. With offices in over 45 countries and the ability to serve customers in over 170 countries, we combine deep local expertise with the scale and delivery of a single global organization.
Our best-in-class vendor portfolio is carefully curated with all leading industry players. Our services range from managed security to specialist technical accreditation and training and capitalize on rapidly evolving technologies and changing business models. For more information visit .

The Channel Sales Manager will be in charged of driving end to end process for achieving sales targets with Channel Partners. The growth from this channel segment will be delivered through three main types of activities:
1) business enablement to help partners grow and expand by cross and up selling
2) plan, design and execute quarterly programs and promote adoption and success

title: Marketing Manager (Online Products, Europe & US Markets)
description:
Our client, the Institute of Metacognitive Programming (IMCP), is seeking a highly skilled Marketing Manager to lead and elevate the promotion of its online educational products on the European and U.S. markets. This is a full-time remote position for a marketing professional with extensive experience in international launches, digital strategy, and content-driven growth who can drive measurable results and scale IMCPs global presence.
About the company
The Institute of Metacognitive Programming delivers training and certification in Metacognitive Programming, a coaching and leadership methodology designed to shift internal thought-emotional patterns and enable sustainable personal and professional transformation. IMCPs vision is to scale this methodology globally, helping professionals, coaches, and leaders achieve meaningful change through approaches grounded in psychology, neuroscience, and philosophy.
As IMCP expands its online programs-including courses, certifications, group coaching, and subscriptions-strategic marketing and high-performing campaigns are critical for audience engagement, conversion, and long-term growth in international markets.
Key Responsibilities

• Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies for online products targeting Europe and the U.S.

• Organize and manage marketing activities across multiple channels.

• Lead project execution, oversee all stages of program launches, and ensure milestones are met.

• Allocate and monitor marketing budgets effectively to maximize ROI.

• Identify new ideas to improve key metrics, optimize conversion at each stage of the funnel, and test hypotheses for scalable growth.

• Implement content strategies that support product promotion and audience engagement.

• Achieve SQL (Sales Qualified Leads) targets through targeted marketing initiatives.

• Manage relationships with contractors, agencies, and external partners.

• Provide weekly and monthly reporting with clear insights on performance and results.

Requirements

• Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar marketing role.

• Proven success promoting educational projects-experience with author-led programs is a strong advantage-in European and U.S. markets.

• Demonstrated experience launching marketing campaigns or programs in new markets.

• Strong organizational and planning skills: ability to create detailed plans, manage schedules, budgets, and prioritize effectively.

• Analytical mindset: ability to structure and process qualitative and quantitative data and draw actionable conclusions.

• Team leadership and collaboration skills: ability to inspire and coordinate cross-functional teams.

• English proficiency at C1 level or higher.

Our Benefits

• Work for a globally recognized and fast-growing coaching and training organization.

• Competitive salary with fixed and performance-based components tied to KPI achievement.

• Fully remote work with flexible scheduling.

• High ownership and influence over IMCPs international marketing strategy and execution.

• Collaborative, learning-oriented team environment.

• Opportunity to shape the promotion of a thought-leadership brand on a global scale.

title: In-Home Health - Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant (Full Time) - Boston
description:
Job Title: In-Home Health - Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant (Full Time) - Boston
Job Location: Work at Home, Massachusetts, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home health clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of our members. We are dedicated to providing care wherever our members call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke, and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA
“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP
“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA
Full-time employees qualify for our comprehensive benefits package, including:

title: Family Offices Services Manager
description:
Family Office Investment Services Manager

About the Role

FSM seeks a CFA Charterholder to lead investment services delivery - and directly manage capital - across a growing roster of ultra-high-net-worth client families. This role carries a dual mandate: you are both the institutional framework builder who ensures every advisor is tracked, benchmarked, and held accountable, and a discretionary portfolio manager with direct responsibility for assigned capital sleeves within each client's overall allocation.

This is a rare seat for a CFA who has managed real money, is fluent in multi-asset portfolio construction, and can simultaneously operate at the orchestration level - sitting above a roster of outside managers - and at the execution level, managing positions directly. You will not be a passive scorekeeper. You will be in the game.

What You'll Own

Discretionary Portfolio Management

• Manage assigned capital sleeves across client portfolios on a fully discretionary basis, spanning liquid equities, fixed income, and select alternatives

• Construct and maintain model portfolios with explicit factor exposures, benchmark targets, and risk budgets approved by the client principal

• Execute investment decisions including security selection, position sizing, rebalancing, and tactical allocation shifts within the agreed investment policy statement (IPS)

• Generate time-weighted and money-weighted return reporting on directly managed sleeves, held to the same S&P 500 benchmark standard applied to all outside managers

• Produce written investment rationale for every material position change - no undocumented trades

• Coordinate with client tax advisors on tax-lot management, wash sale rules, and the interaction between active trading and the client's broader tax posture

Investment Oversight & Multi-Manager Coordination

• Maintain and continuously improve performance measurement frameworks for each client's full advisor roster, benchmarked against the S&P 500 and appropriate secondary indices

• Produce quarterly manager scorecards covering rolling 1-, 3-, and 5-year returns (gross and net of fees), with plain-English summaries written for principals, not advisors

• Build and maintain pairwise correlation matrices and factor-decomposed diversification analyses across all active managers, including directly managed sleeves

• Perform look-through concentration analysis to surface true single-name, sector, geography, and thematic exposures across the entire portfolio - including positions you hold directly

Portfolio Analytics & Risk

• Decompose each manager's results by asset class, sector, and factor exposure (value, growth, size, momentum); apply the same attribution framework to your own directly managed sleeves

• Develop and maintain liquidity waterfall models under defined stress scenarios, incorporating LP lockups, directly held positions, real estate assumptions, and credit line availability

• Monitor concentration risk in real time across all sleeves - both managed externally and managed directly - and escalate when aggregate exposures exceed agreed thresholds

• Partner with the FSM operations team on cross-entity insurance and risk audits, contributing investment-side risk context

Investment Policy & Client Governance

• Draft and maintain a written Investment Policy Statement (IPS) for each client, covering return objectives, risk tolerance, liquidity requirements, constraints, and benchmark selection

• Lead quarterly investment review meetings with family principals; present performance of directly managed sleeves alongside outside manager scorecards in a unified format

• Participate in asset allocation reviews with the client's strategic advisor; provide quantitative support for allocation shift recommendations

• Translate institutional-grade analytics into direct, no-jargon deliverables that respect client sophistication without burying them in unnecessary complexity

Advisor Coordination & Governance

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o  maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina . Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram , criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal , reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões .

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

Nosso time de   Onbording  trabalha com o modelo “presencial”, sendo necessário realizar visitas aos clientes na região de campinas.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

Na área de Marketplace do QuintoAndar, o time de Onboarding é a porta de entrada e o principal guia dos nossos parceiros B2B nos seus primeiros passos conosco. Somos responsáveis por garantir um ramp-up de sucesso, esquentando o relacionamento inicial e estruturando a operação das imobiliárias para que extraiam o máximo valor das nossas soluções de tecnologia e performance desde o dia zero.

Atuamos  logo após a assinatura de contrato pelo time de Hunting e um passo antes do time de Farming . Nosso objetivo é receber a nova parceria, conduzir a imobiliária por toda a jornada de implementação e garantir que as integrações estejam em dia, com o máximo possível de IPs rodando com excelência. Quando a conta está madura e operando perfeitamente, fazemos a passagem de bastão.

Se você é movido(a) por organização, tem forte senso de urgência para fazer as coisas acontecerem no prazo e adora construir as fundações de um relacionamento de alto nível, o seu lugar é aqui.

Suas Responsabilidades

• Transição do Hunting e Kickoffs:  Receber a conta do time comercial logo após a assinatura do contrato e liderar as reuniões de alinhamento inicial com os decisores (donos e diretores de imobiliárias), estabelecendo os próximos passos e expectativas da parceria.

• Garantir o Ramp-up da Conta:  Acompanhar de perto os primeiros dias/meses do parceiro, esquentando o relacionamento e garantindo o engajamento inicial com o modelo do QuintoAndar.

• Gestão de Integrações e IPs:  Assegurar que a imobiliária seja entregue com a integração técnica e operacional totalmente em dia, rodando o máximo possível de IPs com qualidade.

• Reporte e Visibilidade (Status Report):  Mapear e atualizar constantemente o status de cada conta em fase de implementação, garantindo previsibilidade para a liderança e não deixando nenhuma etapa atrasar.

• Handover para Farming:  Realizar uma passagem de bastão fluida, estruturada e rica em informações para o time de Farmer (gestores de contas), garantindo que o cliente já chegue engajado na próxima fase.

• Alimentar e gerenciar ferramentas de CRM  (Hubspot ou similares), assegurando o registro histórico e a eficiência do funil de onboarding.

O que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Organização extrema e alto senso de urgência:  Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos clientes em fase de implementação simultaneamente, sem deixar prazos ou etapas caírem.

• Experiência consolidada em Onboarding, Implementação B2B ou Customer Success, preferencialmente lidando com clientes que exigem integrações e acompanhamento próximo.

title: Specialist, RPT Production Planning and Scheduling
description:

At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb , RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact-on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:

The Specialist, RPT (Radiopharmaceutical Therapies) Production Planning and Scheduling will be responsible for facilitating and managing patient dose scheduling, consistent with RayzeBio corporate goals and program Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines and other applicable federal (FDA) and state regulations. The role will require significant collaboration across internal and external functions to ensure on-time delivery of patient clinical materials. This role will also ensure that such operations activities are timely, efficient, and of the highest quality.
Job Responsibilities

• Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

• Create and maintain detailed study and site tracking for patient dosing schedules across all clinical programs

• Manage and collaborate with internal and external functions for all aspects of the patient treatment schedule and dosing, including scheduling of study participant dosing, receipt and processing of drug product orders, liaison to the Clinical team on the status of drug product manufacturing, shipments and receipt

• Provide support, address issues and facilitate operational continuity for the on-time delivery of patient clinical materials

• Key liaison between the Clinical Site Operations, Supply Chain and Logistics, and Radiochemistry teams

• Identify, mitigate, and manage closely potential risks associated with the on-time delivery of patient clinical materials and escalate accordingly to the Head of Clinical Site Operations and Head of Clinical Operations

• Drive and implement continuous improvement in the planning and scheduling of patient clinical materials

• Collaborate with IT Business Partners in support of modeling and scheduling simulation implementations

• Maintain and update study-level clinical site procedures for RPT dose management

• Performs other tasks as assigned

• Leverage AI tools to enhance individual productivity and quality of work

• Ability to travel approximately 10% of time

Education and Experience

• Minimum 2 years of relevant experience with clinical operations, materials management and/or supply chain

• BA/BS degree

Skills and Qualifications

• Independent professional who proactively communicates frequently and effectively.

• Organized and able to work on multiple projects with tight deadlines.

• High energy level; positive attitude; works well under stress.

• Hands-on, action-oriented, and able to implement effectively.

title: Strategic Projects Lead, Recruiting
locationText: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're looking for a Strategic Projects Lead to take on recruiting's most complex, cross-cutting work: the high-stakes decisions and initiatives that span many teams and don't fit neatly into any one group's remit. You'll bring the structure, coordination, and follow-through that help these get made well, and see them through as the company scales.

You'll work across every team that touches hiring, and you'll move work forward through partnership, not ownership. The job is influence: bring the right people together, make sure decisions are principled and well-documented, and keep recruiting's approach coherent over time. You'll be the most senior individual contributor for how recruiting operates, and success depends as much as on building trust across senior stakeholders with different priorities as it does on building good systems.

This is a high-autonomy role for someone who thrives in complexity and ambiguity. You know recruiting well enough to feel where it breaks, and you're energized by holding several very different problems at once and driving each to a clear resolution.

Key responsibilities

• Take on recruiting's biggest ambiguous bets: define the problem, ship the smallest testable version, and hand each one off as a repeatable program before moving to the next

• Own the operating rhythm across the teams that support recruiting, so we plan, review, and decide as one function

• Spot recurring friction and fix the system behind it, not just the case in front of you

• Own process design when company-wide changes run through recruiting, and drive them to real adoption with the partners who own the build and the comms

• Be recruiting's DRI for headcount and workforce planning, including hiring pace and readiness for new regions

• Own the operating standard for interviewing, like scheduling lead time and interviewer load, and lead the cross-team diagnosis when it slips

• Turn analytics into standards and simple SOPs, and build documentation a new leader could pick up without you in the room

• Keep the right people informed at the right time without becoming a bottleneck, and stay fluent in our recruiting systems and data so you can call the downstream impact of any decision

You'll partner directly with the leads for Recruiting Systems, Analytics, Interview Programs, and other teams. You won't run their teams or build their systems, but you'll know each well enough to make calls that hold up across all of them.

Minimum qualifications

• Have 8-10+ years in program management, business operations, chief of staff, or people/talent roles at a fast-growing company, with increasing scope over time

• Have been part of a talent team or partnered closely with one, and understand how recruiting operates day to day

• Think in systems: you see how the pieces connect, anticipate downstream effects, and design fixes that work across team boundaries

• Have owned several complex workstreams at once and made hard prioritization calls without much guidance

• Set the strategy and vision for your area rather than executing someone else's plan

• Create structure and clarity in genuinely ambiguous environments

title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Detection and Response
description:
TL;DR You'll build the detection and response capability that catches attackers before they matter - across Lovable's corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces.

WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 8+ years in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with at least 3 at staff/principal level.

- Strong engineering background - you build detections as code, not as saved searches in a SIEM.

- Deep experience with cloud telemetry (GCP/AWS/Cloudflare), endpoint EDR, identity logs, and modern SIEM/data-lake stacks (Panther, Elastic, Snowflake/Clickhouse).

- Battle-tested incident commander who has led real high-severity incidents from first alert to public post-mortem.

- Adversary-minded: comfortable with MITRE ATT&CK, threat intel, purple-teaming, and red team collaboration.

- Bonus: detection for LLM/agent abuse, prompt injection at scale, or insider risk in AI-augmented engineering orgs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build the detection engineering platform - pipelines, detections-as-code, automated triage, and response playbooks.

- Design and own security incident response process with 24/7 coverage, with a small, high-leverage human and agent team.

- Lead incidents end-to-end: detection, containment, eradication, post-mortem, and follow-through.

- Hunt proactively across corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces - and turn every finding into a durable detection.

- Define what 'world-class D&R for an AI-native company' looks like, and build it.

OUR TECH STACK

- Frontend: React and Typescript.

- Backend: Golang and Rust.

- Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.

- DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).

- Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.

And we’re always exploring what’s next!

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Clinical Pharmacist
description:
Job Description Summary
‎
The Clinical Pharmacist I supports clinical pharmacy programs by performing medication therapy review, drug utilization review, patient and provider outreach, and medication-related quality initiative support within established protocols. This job applies clinical pharmacy training to routine patient care situations.
Clinical Pharmacist I makes clinical decisions within defined scope, with close guidance from senior clinical pharmacy staff. This job builds practical experience in value-based care, medication adherence, high-risk medication review, and interdisciplinary collaboration while contributing to safe, effective, and affordable medication use. ‎
How will you make an impact & Requirements
‎
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct medication therapy reviews and targeted patient outreach for routine clinical pharmacy initiatives under established protocols.

• Review medication-related quality care gaps, including adherence and statin-use opportunities, and support patient or provider follow-up to improve outcomes.

• Assess prescription histories, medication lists, refill patterns, and basic drug utilization information to identify issues requiring pharmacist intervention or escalation.

• Collaborate with providers, care managers, pharmacy technicians, and other care team members to support medication adherence, safety, affordability, and access.

• Educate patients and caregivers on medication use, adherence barriers, affordability resources, and pharmacist-approved care plan actions within scope.

• Document clinical assessments, outreach results, recommendations, and follow-up actions accurately in applicable systems.

• Review pharmacy technician-collected medication histories and outreach documentation for accuracy and clinical relevance as needed.

• Perform comprehensive utilization management reviews for Medicare Part B-covered medical drugs, including evaluation of medical necessity, alignment with FDA labeling and compendia-supported indications, prior authorization requests, step therapy protocols, and site-of-care optimization to support cost-effective, high-quality outcomes while minimizing total cost of care.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with medical directors, providers, and care management teams on Part B and Part D drug utilization trends, denial/appeal processes, and exception requests; apply evidence-based criteria and Medicare coverage determinations to ensure appropriate utilization, support Stars/HEDIS quality measures, and drive value-based care initiatives such as biosimilar adoption and transitions from hospital outpatient to lower-cost infusion settings.

• Participate in an interdisciplinary Model of Care for Medicare Special Needs Populations.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Doctor of Pharmacy degree or other pharmacy degree from an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy required.

title: Laser Architect (f/m/d)
description:
Focused Energy is a fusion energy startup with the goal of generating unlimited clean energy to responsibly meet future global demand. With the use and commercialization of laser-induced inertial fusion, a clean and highly efficient power generation technology is coming within reach, suitable to ensure a secure and scalable future energy supply.

We are seeking a Laser Architect to join our dynamic laser development team. The Laser Architect is the system‑level technical lead responsible for the conceptual design, modeling, and experimental validation of laser driver architectures for inertial fusion energy (IFE) at the research and pre‑pilot stage.

This role focuses on defining and evolving credible laser driver concepts that can ultimately support fusion energy production, while operating primarily at the R&D and demonstrator level, where performance exploration, risk reduction, and physics‑driven trade studies dominate over industrial optimization.

The Laser Architect ensures coherence between laser physics, system architecture, and fusion requirements, guiding the transition from laboratory concepts toward scalable driver solutions. They enable the transition of inertial fusion energy from proof‑of‑principle laser experiments toward credible, scalable driver concepts, shaping the technical foundations on which future pilot plants and commercial systems will be built.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

- Define and refine laser driver concepts suitable for IFE.

- Explore alternative architectures and assess their feasibility through modeling and experiments.

- Maintain ownership of the global architectural vision, even as individual subsystems evolve in parallel.

- Define the laser R&D roadmap, including critical component development/evaluation, integrated beamline demonstrators, and intermediate testbeds

- Work closely with experimental teams to ensure results feed back into architectural decisions

- Support design of diagnostics and test protocols aligned with future scaling needs.

WHO YOU ARE:

- PhD or equivalent experience in laser physics, optical engineering, or related fields

- Deep expertise in high‑energy and/or high‑average‑power laser systems

- Strong background in laser system modeling and scaling analysis

- Demonstrated experience in conceptual design and experimental validation of complex laser systems

- Ability to operate across physics, optics, and systems‑level reasoning

- Ability to bridge theoretical modeling and experimental reality

- Operates as a system thinker with strong physics intuition

- Comfortable exploring multiple architectural paths in parallel

- Values quantitative modeling, experimental feedback, and iterative refinement

- Communicates technical trade‑offs clearly to scientists, engineers, and leadership

WHAT WE OFFER:

title: Principal Engineer — Graph & API
description:
As a Principal Engineer within Servicing Digital, you'll help define and deliver Rocket's next generation of client-facing servicing experiences for millions of homeowners. Servicing Digital owns the end-to-end digital journey for clients after close - powering 's Rocket Mortgage Servicing platform and every interaction a client has with their loan, their account, and their servicer. We are entering a pivotal chapter - a full-scale System of Record modernization that will reshape the technical foundation beneath our client experiences and redefine how servicing works through AI-driven workflows and decisioning. The engineers who join us now will not inherit a finished system. They will build the one that replaces it. The Graph & API domain sits at the center of that transformation. You'll architect and govern the abstraction layer that keeps our client-facing products stable and decoupled as the systems beneath them change. Your work will determine how fast the vertical can move, how safely teams can ship, and how confidently Rocket can execute one of its most consequential technology investments.

Principal Engineers provide cross-organizational technical leadership, operating across multiple divisions and domains to drive enterprise-wide technology standards, build advanced platforms, and accelerate internal transformation. As key thought leaders, Principal Engineers define and influence technical strategy, shape engineering culture, and represent engineering in executive-level discussions. They introduce and scale innovative solutions - including AI and automation throughout the software development lifecycle - that materially impact the company and industry. In the Graph & API role, this mandate is sharpened by urgency: a full-scale System of Record migration makes stable, well-governed API abstractions a business-critical dependency. You will own the technical strategy for how Servicing Digital's graph and API layer is designed, governed, and evolved - ensuring that client experiences remain fast, coherent, and decoupled from the migration happening beneath them.
About the role

• Define and own the API and graph architecture strategy for Servicing Digital, including schema design, federation patterns, and versioning governance.

• Architect and steward the abstraction layer that decouples client-facing experiences from underlying systems during and after the System of Record migration.

• Establish API design standards, schema governance practices, and developer contracts that scale across multiple product teams.

• Guide technology adoption across GraphQL, schema federation, REST, and event-driven integration patterns.

• Build and maintain API platform tooling, documentation standards, and developer experience infrastructure that accelerates team velocity.

• Integrate and advocate for AI-assisted tooling throughout the API development lifecycle.

• Mentor engineers and technical leads, elevating graph and API craft across the vertical.

• Represent Servicing Digital's API strategy in architecture reviews, executive discussions, and cross-vertical technical forums.

About you

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's or higher in Computer Science or a related field.

• 12+ years in professional software engineering and architecture roles.

• Demonstrated experience leading API or graph platform strategy at enterprise scale.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced expertise in GraphQL, schema federation, API design and governance, REST, and event-driven integration patterns.

• Demonstrated experience designing abstraction layers that insulate consumer experiences from backend system changes, including migrations and re-platforming efforts.

• Deep fluency in TypeScript and AWS-native service patterns relevant to API and graph infrastructure.

• Track record of establishing API standards and governance that scale across multiple teams and domains.

title: Nuclear Operations Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Nuclear Operations Engineer to join our Operations Engineering team.

Position Description

The Nuclear Operations Engineer supports the development and implementation of the operational capabilities needed to safely commission, start up, and operate Oklo facilities. This role translates plant designs, safety requirements, and program requirements into practical methods for operating the plant and conducting operational work.

The Nuclear Operations Engineer helps develop operational programs and the procedures used to implement those programs. The role also provides technical and operational input for normal, general, abnormal, emergency, surveillance, alarm-response, and administrative operating procedures. Working with procedure writers, system engineers, and other subject-matter experts, this engineer helps ensure procedures are technically accurate, operationally practical, and aligned with plant design and program requirements.

This role also supports system turnover, testing, commissioning, startup, and operational-readiness activities across Oklo projects. The Nuclear Operations Engineer may serve as a system owner, technical lead, procedure subject-matter expert, test engineer, or field operations resource depending on the project phase and organizational need.

The Nuclear Operations Engineer works across Operations, Engineering, Regulatory, Safety Analysis, Human Factors, Maintenance, Training, Commissioning and Startup, and other organizations to ensure that Oklo facilities can successfully transition from design and construction into safe and reliable operation.

This position is primarily remote. Travel and temporary onsite assignments will be required as needed to support Oklo facilities, commissioning and startup campaigns, operational projects, design reviews, vendor activities, training, and other company priorities.

title: CX Specialist
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Customer Experience (CX) Specialist, you will be the first line of support for both internal teams and external customers. This role is designed for support professionals with prior customer-facing experience who thrive in fast-paced environments, are eager to keep growing, and are excited to contribute to Harvey's rapid growth.

You'll focus on managing a high volume of non-technical support tickets, ensuring a seamless experience for our users. Over time, you'll have the opportunity to expand your technical skills, gain exposure to more complex support workflows, and progress within our CX team.

This role is built for support professionals ready to deepen their foundation in a technical product environment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Act as the first point of contact for non-technical support inquiries, ensuring timely, empathetic, and accurate responses.

- Exercise sound judgment on ticket routing; knowing when to resolve independently and when to escalate to a senior support specialist.

- Own your queue: manage ticket volume against SLA targets without sacrificing response quality. Customers should always receive accurate, complete answers that reflect Harvey's standard of care.

- Apply consistent, accurate ticket tagging and categorization to support team-wide reporting and trend visibility.

- Maintain a strong working knowledge of Harvey's core product features to provide clear and effective guidance.

- Follow established playbooks and macros with precision; flag gaps or inconsistencies so the team can improve them over time.

- Contribute to FAQs, internal guides, and knowledge base articles that streamline support for recurring questions; surface content gaps when customer questions reveal missing or unclear documentation.

- Partner with the Customer Education team to flag areas where self-serve content can reduce repeat contact volume.

- Stay adaptable and proactive in a rapidly evolving startup environment, operating effectively even when processes or product features are changing quickly.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- 2 years of professional experience in customer support at a SaaS company in the technology industry.

- Experience with customer support platforms (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce) and working fluency with AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini); you use them, not just know of them.

- Strong written communication skills; clear, professional, and appropriately calibrated to the audience, whether a law firm partner or an internal stakeholder.

- Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with competing priorities and limited process documentation.

- High process consistency: you follow established workflows reliably and flag when something doesn't fit the playbook rather than improvising silently.

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

You'll be embedded with our marketing team, turning campaign, web and funnel data into the decisions that drive demand and pipeline. Sitting within the analytics team alongside our analysts and analytics engineers, you'll own marketing analytics end-to-end, from instrumentation through to the insight that shapes where we spend.

- Own the inbound funnel metrics end-to-end. Define and own the metrics across landing → MQL → SQL → trial → conversion, so marketing, sales and leadership trust the same numbers.

- Build multi-touch attribution. Move beyond last-touch UTM tracking to attribution that shows which channels and campaigns actually drive pipeline and revenue.

- Own web and SEO analytics. Track website traffic, SEO performance and inbound lead quality, and turn it into clear recommendations.

ABOUT YOU

You're a senior, hands-on individual contributor with real technical depth who thrives on turning marketing and funnel data into decisions that move pipeline and revenue.

- Proven analytics experience supporting marketing, growth, demand gen or RevOps, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech.

- Expert SQL for complex analysis, optimisation and reusable datasets.

- dbt & a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake or similar) - commercial experience building production models, tests and docs.

- Modern BI with an integrated semantic layer - building self-serve dashboards and owning metric definitions (e.g. Omni, Looker, Thoughtspot).

- Deep knowledge of the marketing stack - HubSpot (or similar automation/CRM), Salesforce, Google Analytics and digital/web/event analytics.

- Attribution and funnel expertise - multi-touch attribution, CAC, conversion and LTV/payback, with the statistical judgement to separate signal from noise.

- A strong communicator who turns analysis into clear narratives marketing and leadership can act on.

- Strategic problem solver who owns metric definitions and builds validation so numbers are trusted across teams.

- Bonus: Python for deeper analysis; experience with paid-media analytics, SEO or marketing experimentation.

Position Summary

Radiology Partners is seeking a full-time Board Certified/Board Eligible General Radiologist for new sites in Spokane, WA.

Our major local health system is a 388-bed acute care, Level III Trauma Center. This facility offers inpatient, outpatient, diagnostic imaging, medical, surgical, and emergency services. This hospital is part of a larger locally owned, not-for-profit health care system, providing care throughout the Inland Northwest. This position will also assist with coverage at Valley Hospital, which is a 123-bed acute care facility with a Level III trauma center. The Radiology Department provides all aspects of Diagnostic Imaging, Breast and Women’s Imaging and Interventional Radiology.

This position will interpret STAT/ER, inpatient and outpatient cases including but not limited to general modalities such as body, thoracic, neuro, ultrasound, and on occasion nuclear. Any successful candidate will share Radiology Partners ’ vision for fostering an integrative and collaborative care model while working within a multi-disciplinary team. The city is a haven for outdoor adventure seekers, with abundant unparalleled recreation, a gorgeous landscape, and a beloved riverfront park home to a picturesque waterfall. There are 76 lakes within an hour’s drive of Spokane. The city's western suburb of Airway Heights is home to Spokane International Airport, Fairchild Air Force Base, as well as two large casino hotels. As one of the best places to live in the U.S., locals have access to great education and health care options and a diverse economy that is considered a central hub for the Inland.

As a new location for Radiology Partners , we are seeking candidates who enjoy building a practice and establishing relationships with referring clinicians.

• Experienced radiologists are encouraged to apply

title: ML Security Engineer
description:
ML Security Engineer- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: ML Security Engineer
Location:  100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type:  Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range:  $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required:  6+ years

Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an AI Security Engineer to lead the design and implementation of security controls, threat models, and incident response capabilities specifically tailored to AI and machine learning systems. The role addresses the unique security challenges posed by LLMs, model APIs, training data pipelines, and AI-powered applications, including prompt injection, model abuse, data exfiltration, and supply chain risks. The ideal candidate has strong security engineering fundamentals and a deep understanding of how modern AI systems work in practice, with hands-on experience designing defenses for both AI-powered applications and the AI infrastructure that supports them.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and implement security controls specifically targeting LLM and AI-powered application risks.

• Build threat models for AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, and abuse patterns.

• Design and deploy guardrails, content filters, and policy enforcement layers around model endpoints.

• Implement runtime detection and response capabilities for adversarial prompts and abusive behavior.

• Secure training and fine-tuning pipelines, including data provenance, integrity, and access controls.

• Design controls for sensitive data handling, retention, and redaction in LLM workflows.

• Lead red-team exercises against AI systems and drive remediation of identified weaknesses.

• Evaluate and harden third-party AI services and open-source AI components used internally.

• Implement identity, authorization, and tenant-isolation patterns for multi-tenant AI services.

• Drive supply chain security for ML artifacts including weights, datasets, and inference dependencies.

• Collaborate with privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure AI systems meet regulatory obligations.

• Develop monitoring, logging, and detection strategies tailored to AI workloads.

• Lead incident response for AI-specific security events and drive durable improvements.

• Stay current with adversarial ML, LLM security research, and emerging regulatory developments.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.

• Six or more years of security engineering experience, including significant work on AI or ML systems.

• Strong understanding of LLM internals, modern AI architectures, and common failure modes.

• Hands-on experience designing security controls for AI-powered applications.

• Deep knowledge of application security, identity, and cryptography fundamentals.

• Experience with threat modeling and security architecture review processes.

• Familiarity with adversarial ML, prompt injection, and model abuse research.

• Proficiency in Python and at least one systems language.

• Strong understanding of cloud security and modern infrastructure controls.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Publications, talks, or CTF participation in AI security topics.

• Experience with red-teaming LLM-based products.

• Familiarity with privacy-preserving ML techniques such as differential privacy.

• Exposure to regulated industries with strict data handling requirements.

• Open-source contributions to AI security tooling

Wayve’s engineering teams are building the AI, robotics, simulation, data, and systems foundations needed to deploy a generalisable AI Driver safely and at scale.

ABOUT VEHICLE GENERALIZATION

The Vehicle Generalization team enables efficient, scalable, and predictable deployment of the Wayve autonomous-driving stack across different vehicle platforms. The team tackles the practical controls, localization, odometry, integration, and debugging challenges that determine whether autonomous systems work reliably in the real world.

- Real-world vehicle-platform bring-up and system integration.

- Controls, localization, odometry, state estimation, and sensor-fusion problems.

- Latency, synchronization, filtering, and signal-processing issues.

- Generalisation benchmarks and metrics across multiple vehicle platforms.

- Customer deployments where practical problem-solving directly affects programme success.

- You are highly proficient in C++ and comfortable using Python for analysis and prototyping.

- You have 3+ years of hands-on robotics, autonomy, or automotive experience.

- You bring practical experience in controls, state estimation, localization, odometry, or sensor fusion.

- You can diagnose complex integration issues using data, systems thinking, and direct platform interaction.

- You operate independently in ambiguity and communicate effectively across technical teams.

- You are willing to work hands-on in Sunnyvale and travel domestically or internationally for customer and vehicle support.

MORE ABOUT WAYVE

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution from L2+ through to L4.

HOW WE WORK 💻 - LOCATIONS & FLEXIBLE WORKING

This role is based in Sunnyvale and requires regular hands-on collaboration with vehicles and engineering teams. Wayve operates a hybrid working model, with travel for vehicle and customer support when needed.

- Technical screen covering core robotics and code implementations (45 min)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
